title: 第586章 白衣定死罪无辩亦是辩第585章 冷风过峰真假无辩
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
世上最狠的定罪，从不是刀兵加身。
是开口即判，不给半分辩驳余地。
仙盟的风，是冷的。
比归仙峰常年不息的山风，冷上百倍。
山间的风，只会吹乱衣衫，吹散晨雾。
仙盟的风，能吹灭人心，定人生死，倾覆一宗基业。
云海之上，三道白衣悬立虚空。
衣袂绣凌霄云纹，随罡风轻拂，不染一尘，却自带俯瞰三界的森严傲慢。
为首的巡察使眉目清隽，面皮白净无温，一双眸子淡得像结了千年寒冰的深潭，不见喜怒，只剩审判众生的漠然。
他叫沈清寒，凌霄仙盟核心巡察官。
掌三界宗门稽查、正邪裁定、道统归序，手握无名之权——
他说你正，百邪可赦。
他说你邪，百辩徒劳。
这便是正统道统，最霸道的规矩。
山风彻底止息。
整座归仙峰，落针可闻。
田间修士僵立原地，指尖的灵锄悬在半空，泥土簌簌坠落，砸在青石板上，细碎声响在死寂里被无限放大。
工坊炉火依旧噼啪轻响，可再无人觉暖意，那点点温热，在此刻滔天威压下，渺小得如同萤火对皓月。
巡山的猫武团修士，甲衣贴身，脊背绷得笔直，可紧握兵刃的指节，早已泛出青白。
人心的慌，从来藏不住。

眼底的犹疑、心底的摇摆、潜意识里的怯懦，在正统仙盟的威压面前，尽数暴露无遗。
昨日的安稳是真。
今日的惶恐，亦是真。
没人天生不惧天规正统。
归仙峰众修，半生多被仙门正统排挤、定性为异类、视作旁门末流。
三年漂泊流离，一朝立宗扎根，看似心气渐稳，可刻在骨血里的自卑与忌惮，从未彻底消弭。
就像寻常百姓，纵使立身正、行事端，一朝被朝堂大员当众问罪，也难免心神震颤，自我怀疑。
这便是伪天棋局最阴毒的地方。
它不用蛊毒杀人，不用术法破山。
它只借正统之名，挑动人心深处最脆弱的猜忌，不战，先乱其心。
沈清寒目光缓缓扫过整座山峦，视线掠过灵田、工坊、巡山阵列，最后落回巍峨主峰。
他的眼神很平。
可就是这平淡的目光，却带着覆压万钧的审判力，压得满山草木低伏，灵气凝滞不流。
“喵仙宗，私蓄异数，隐匿蛊患，惑乱三界视听。”
他再一次开口，声音朗朗，穿透云层山峦，落进每一个归仙峰修士耳中。
字字冰冷，句句钉死。
没有证据。
不需证据。
仙盟稽查，即是天道定论。
“三桩罪名，桩桩触逆凌霄道统，违逆三界秩序。”

“林墨，身为主峰宗主，掌一宗兴衰，纵容妖力盘踞仙山，隐匿灾患不报，可知罪？”
问话落地，不是问询。
content_en:
The most severe punishment in the world is never the use of weapons.
It's a judgment that comes right out of the mouth, leaving no room for argument.
The wind in the Immortal League is cold.
It is a hundred times colder than the constant mountain wind at Guixian Peak.
The wind in the mountains will only ruffle clothes and disperse the morning fog.
The wind of the Immortal Alliance can blow away people's hearts, determine life and death, and overturn a sect's foundation.
Above the sea of ​​clouds, three white clothes hang in the sky.
The clothes are embroidered with cloud patterns in the sky, blowing gently in the strong wind, and are not stained by dust, but they have the solemn and arrogant look of overlooking the three realms.
The leading inspector's brows were clear, his face was white and without warmth, and his eyes were as pale as a deep pool frozen with thousands of years of ice. There was no joy or anger, only the indifference of judging all living beings.
His name is Shen Qinghan, the core inspector of the Lingxiao Immortal Alliance.
In charge of the inspection of sects in the three realms, the determination of good and evil, and the ordering of Taoism. He holds the nameless power——
He said you are righteous and all evil can be forgiven.
He said you are evil, and arguing is in vain.
This is orthodox Taoism, the most overbearing rule.
The mountain wind completely stopped.
The entire Guixian Peak can be heard as a needle drops.
The monk in the field stood frozen on the spot, with the spiritual hoe at his fingertips hanging in mid-air. The soil fell with a rustling sound and hit the bluestone. The sound of cracking was infinitely amplified in the dead silence.
The fire in the workshop still crackled softly, but no one felt the warmth anymore. That little bit of warmth, under the overwhelming pressure at this moment, was as small as a firefly against the bright moon.
The monks of the Cat Military Regiment who were patrolling the mountain wore armor that was close to their skin and their backs were straight, but the knuckles that could hold their weapons tightly were already turning green and white.
People's panic can never be hidden.
The hesitation in his eyes, the wavering in his heart, and the cowardice in his subconscious were all exposed in the face of the pressure of the Orthodox Immortal Alliance.
The stability of yesterday is real.
Today's fear is also true.
No one is born without fear of orthodoxy.
Returning to the Immortal Peak cultivators, he was ostracized by the orthodox Immortal Sect for most of his life, characterized as an alien, and regarded as a member of the outside world.
After three years of wandering and wandering, once he established his clan and took root, his mind seemed to have gradually stabilized, but the inferiority complex and fear engraved in his bones and blood had never been completely eliminated.
Just like ordinary people, even if they stand upright and behave properly, they will inevitably feel trembled and self-doubt when they are questioned by court officials in public.
This is the most sinister part of the pseudo-tian chess game.
It doesn't use poison to kill people, and it doesn't use magic to break mountains.
It only uses the name of orthodoxy to stir up the most fragile suspicions deep in people's hearts. Without fighting, it first confuses their hearts.
Shen Qinghan's eyes slowly swept across the entire mountain, passing by the spiritual fields, workshops, and mountain patrol arrays, and finally returned to the majestic main peak.
His eyes were level.
But this plain gaze carries an overwhelming power of judgment, which makes the mountains and trees droop, and the spiritual energy is stagnant.
"The Meow Immortal Sect secretly accumulates strange numbers, hides poisons, and confuses the sight and hearing of the three realms."
He spoke again, his voice loud and clear, penetrating the clouds and mountains, and falling into the ears of every Guixian Peak monk.
Every word is cold and every sentence is nailed.
There is no evidence.
No evidence is required.
The inspection of the Immortal Alliance is the final conclusion of heaven.
"Three crimes, all of which violate Lingxiao's orthodoxy and violate the order of the three realms."
"Lin Mo, as the master of the main peak sect, is responsible for the rise and fall of a sect, allows the demon power to occupy the fairy mountain, hides disasters and does not avenge them, is this a crime?"
The question is grounded, not an inquiry.
